title: Isolation of human ESC-derived cardiac derivatives and embryonic heart cells for population and single-cell RNA-seq analysis
protocol: Dissociate hESCs cultured on maintenance plates with 80%–90% confluency into single cells.
Seed dissociated hESCs on differentiation plates.
Aspirate the old mTeSR1 medium from Matrigel-coated 6-well plates.
Wash the cells with DPBS once.
Add 1 mL of Accutase to each well.
Incubate the plate in a 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator for 5–10 minutes.
Add 1 mL of mTeSR1 or fetal bovine serum (FBS) to each well.
Collect all cells into a 15-mL conical tube by gently pipetting.
Warm all medium, serum, and solutions at 20°C–25°C for more than 20–30 minutes before use.
Count the total cell number using an automated cell counter or a hemocytometer.
Centrifuge the pooled cells at 200 × g for 5 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cells in mTeSR1 supplemented with 5 μM Y-27632 (a ROCK inhibitor) at an appropriate cell density (e.g., 0.5–1 million cells per mL).
Seed 250,000–500,000 dissociated cells in a final volume of 1 mL media (mTeSR1 + 5 μM Y-27632) per well of Matrigel-coated 12-well plates.
Replace the medium daily with 1 mL of fresh mTeSR1 per well of the 12-well plate from days −3 to −1.
Aspirate the old mTeSR1 medium and add 2 mL of RPMI/B27-ins supplemented with 12 μM CHIR99021 per well of the 12-well plate.
Replace the RPMI/B27-ins medium containing CHIR99021 with fresh RPMI/B27-ins medium precisely after 24 hours.
Collect 1 mL of the old medium per well into a 50-mL conical tube for preparing semi-conditioned medium supplemented with IWP2 on day 3.
Mix 1 mL of fresh RPMI/B27-ins with existing medium at a 1:1 ratio.
Add 2 μL of 5 mM IWP2 to 2 mL of the semi-conditioned medium (final concentration 5 μM).
Aspirate 1 mL of the old medium per well and add 2 mL of the semi-conditioned medium supplemented with IWP2.
Aspirate the semi-conditioned medium containing IWP2 on day 5 (96 hours after adding CHIR99021) and replace it with 2 mL of fresh RPMI/B27-ins medium per well.
On day 7, aspirate the old RPMI/B27-ins medium and add 2 mL of fresh RPMI supplemented with B27 per well.
Replace the medium every 2 or 3 days thereafter with 2 mL of fresh RPMI/B27 per well.
Aspirate the old medium on the differentiation 12-well plates and wash the cells with DPBS once.
Add 0.5 mL of Accutase to each well of the 12-well plate.
Put the plate in a 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator for 5–10 min.
Add 0.5 mL of mTeSR1 or FBS to each well.
Collect all the cells into a 15-mL conical tube by gently pipetting.
Centrifuge the pooled cells at 200 × g for 5 min at 20°C–25°C.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cells in 100 μL of DPBS.
Count the total cell number using an automated cell counter or a hemocytometer.
Centrifuge the cells at 200 × g for 5 min at 20°C–25°C.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cells in Blocking/Staining Solution A.
Divide the cell solution into separate 1.5 mL tubes for unstained and single color-stained controls, and multicolor-stained samples.
Do blocking of the cells in Blocking/Staining Solution A on the shaker at 4°C for 15 min.
Centrifuge the cells at 200 × g for 5 min at 20°C–25°C.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cells in 100–200 μL of primary antibodies’ solution (Blocking/Staining Solution A + appropriately diluted primary antibodies).
Incubate the cells on the shaker at 4°C for 30–60 min.
Centrifuge the cells at 200 × g for 5 min at 20°C–25°C and wash the cells with 300 μL of DPBS.
Repeat step 11e. Centrifuge the cells at 200 × g for 5 min at 20°C–25°C and aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 300 μL of FACS buffer.
Filter the cell solution into a 5 mL FACS tube.
Keep the FACS tubes on ice until detection.
Stain live cells with DAPI or PI immediately before FACS running.
If primary antibody is not conjugated, stain cells with fluorochrome-conjugated secondary antibody at 1:500–1,000 dilution in Blocking/Staining Solution A for 15 min at 4°C.
Return to step 11e-g and then follow either step 12a or 12c if staining for inner cell proteins is planned.
If staining for inner cell proteins is concurrently planned, go to step 13.
Fix cells with a 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) solution on the shaker at 20°C–25°C for 20–25 minutes.
Wrap cell tubes in aluminum foil.
Centrifuge the cells at 400 × g for 5 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cells in 1 mL of permeabilization solution.
Repeat step 14.
Centrifuge the cells at 400 × g for 5 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cells in 0.5 mL of blocking/staining solution B.
Do blocking of the cells in blocking/staining solution B on the shaker at 4°C for 15 minutes.
Wrap cell tubes in aluminum foil.
Centrifuge the cells at 400 × g for 5 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cells in 100–200 μL of primary antibodies’ solution (blocking/staining solution B + appropriately diluted primary antibodies for inner cell proteins).
Incubate the cells on the shaker at 4°C for 30–60 min.
Centrifuge the cells at 400 × g for 5 min at 20°C–25°C.
Wash the cells with 300 μL of PBS.
Repeat step 17e.
Centrifuge the cells at 400 × g for 5 min at 20°C–25°C.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Stain the cells with a fluorochrome-conjugated secondary antibody specific to the appropriate species on the shaker at 4°C for 15 min.
Centrifuge the cells at 400 × g for 5 min at 20°C–25°C.
Wash the cells with 300 μL of PBS.
Repeat step 17i.
Centrifuge the cells at 400 × g for 5 min at 20°C–25°C.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in 300 μL of FACS buffer.
Filter the cell solutions into a 5 mL FACS tube.
Keep the FACS tubes on ice until detection.
Analyze and sort the stained cells using a flow cytometer and cell sorter.
Equip the sorter with a 100 μm nozzle at 4°C temperature.
Maintain the flow rate between 800–1,200 events per second.
Use unstained and single color-stained controls to set PMT voltages.
Adjust compensation using a cell analyzing software.
Gate single cells based on FSC-A versus SSC-A plot.
Discard doublets by gating single cells with FSC-W versus FSC-H plot.
Exclude debris using the SSC-W versus SSC-H plot.
Gate DAPI- or PI-negative populations for live cell sorting.
Create appropriate sorting gates through analysis of isotype antibody-stained controls and marker-positive/negative cell-type controls.
Sort ISL1+PDGFRα+ MCPs on day 3.
Sort ISL1+Lin (TNNT2, HCN4, SMMHC, PECAM1)+ cardiac intermediates on day 6.
Sort ISL1-Lin+ differentiated cardiac cells including cardiomyocytes, pacemaker cells, smooth muscle cells, and endothelial cells on day 10.
Collect more than 10,000 (preferably ≥20,000) fixed cells of each population into pre-coated tubes containing 100 μL PBS.
Centrifuge cells in 1.5 mL tubes at 400 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Clean lab environments with an RNase decontamination solution before starting RNA work.
Resuspend cell pellets in 100 μL of Digestion Buffer with 4 μL of Protease.
Incubate the mixture in a heat block or water bath at 50°C for 1 hour.
Snap-freeze and store cell lysates at -80°C for up to 2-4 weeks.
Combine 120 μL of Isolation Additive and 275 μL of 100% ethanol.
Add 395 μL of the Isolation Additive/ethanol mixture into the cell lysate from step 19.
Mix by gently pipetting.
Pipette the cell lysate/ethanol mixture onto a filter cartridge placed in a collection tube.
Centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 30 s to pass the mixture through the filter.
Discard the flow-through and re-set the filter cartridge in the same collection tube.
Add 700 μL of Wash 1 to the filter cartridge.
Centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 30 s.
Discard the flow-through and re-set the filter cartridge in the same collection tube.
Add 500 μL of Wash 2/3 to the filter cartridge.
Centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 30 s.
Discard the flow-through and re-set the filter cartridge in the same collection tube.
Centrifuge the assembly at 10,000 × g for an additional 30 s to remove residual fluid from the filter.
Combine 4 μL of DNase, 6 μL of 10× DNase buffer, and 50 μL of nuclease-free water.
Add 60 μL of DNase mix to the center of the filter cartridge.
Cap the tube and incubate for 30 min at 20°C–25°C.
Add 700 μL of Wash 1 to the filter cartridge.
Incubate for 60 s at 20°C–25°C.
Centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 30 s.
Discard the flow-through and re-set the filter cartridge in the same collection tube.
Add 500 μL of Wash 2/3 to the filter cartridge.
Centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 30 s.
Discard the flow-through and re-set the filter cartridge in the same collection tube.
Repeat steps involving Wash 2/3 and centrifugation.
Centrifuge the assembly at 10,000 × g for 1 min to remove residual fluid from the filter.
Transfer the filter cartridge to a fresh collection tube.
Apply 20–60 μL of Elution Solution or nuclease-free water to the center of the filter cartridge.
Close the cap and place the sample at 20°C–25°C for 1 min.
Centrifuge for 1 min at maximum speed to pass the mixture through the filter.
Transfer human embryonic/fetal hearts into 35 mm dishes filled with 5 mL DMEM/F12 on ice immediately after surgery.
Dissect the hearts under a microscope into outflow tract, ventricle, and atria using scissors and forceps.
Remove fatty and connective tissues from each dissected heart compartment.
Transfer each dissected region into different 35 mm dishes filled with 5 mL Heart-Primary solution on ice.
Cut each region into small pieces as possible using scissors and forceps.
Transfer cut pieces of each region into 3 mL of Collagenase A solution in a 15 mL tube, separately.
Prepare fresh collagenase A and B solutions every time.
Place the tubes into a water bath at 37°C with shaking for 10 min.
Centrifuge the tubes at 200 × g for 3 min.
Discard the supernatant carefully in each tube.
Add 3 mL of Collagenase B solution into the 15 mL tubes.
Gently tap the bottom of the tubes.
Place the tubes into a water bath at 37°C with shaking for 25 min.
Transfer and pass the suspension including dissociated single cells through a 40-μm cell strainer into a new 50 mL tube filled with 1 mL of FBS for neutralization.
If there are still clearly visible residual tissues, add another 3 mL of Collagenase B solution into the same 15 mL tube after transferring the supernatant and repeat the dissociation step.
Centrifuge the 50 mL tubes at 200 × g for 3 min.
Discard the supernatant carefully.
Resuspend the cells in 200 μL of Cell Suspension Buffer.
Transfer the cell solutions into a new 35 mm dish.
Pick single cells using a micro capillary pipette under a microscope.
Transfer each single cell into a 0.2-mL thin-walled PCR tube containing 2 μL of Cell Lysis Buffer, 1 μL of 10 μM oligo-dT primer, and 1 μL of 10 mM dNTP mix.
Snap-freeze the tubes on dry ice.
Store the tubes in a freezer at -80°C for 2-4 weeks.
Filter the cell solutions into a 5 mL FACS tube.
Keep the FACS tubes on ice until detection.
Sort DAPI- or PI-negative live cells as one cell per well on 96- or 384-well plates containing Cell Lysis Buffer, oligo-dT primer, and dNTP mix.
Centrifuge the plate at 200 × g for 30 s before sorting cells.
Snap-freeze the 96- or 384-well plates on dry ice after cell sorting.
Store the sorted cells in a freezer at -80°C until cDNA library construction.
Transfer 100 pg of total RNA from bulk populations into a 0.2-mL thin-walled PCR tube.
Add 1 μL of 10 μM oligo-dT primer and 1 μL of 10 mM dNTP mix to the RNA sample.
Denature RNA solutions at 72°C for 3 min and immediately place on ice afterward.
Add 5.7 μL of reverse transcription (RT) mix to each sample, containing 0.5 μL of SuperScript II reverse transcriptase and 0.1 μL of 100 μM Template-switching oligo.
Mix the reaction by gently pipetting.
Spin down the samples at 600 × g for 15 s at 20°C–25°C.
Incubate the sample tubes in a thermal cycler at 42°C for 90 minutes.
Perform 10 cycles of incubation: 50°C for 2 minutes followed by 42°C for 2 minutes.
Incubate the samples at 70°C for 15 minutes.
Add 15 μL of PCR pre-amplification mix to each sample, including 12.5 μL of KAPA HiFi HotStart Ready Mix (2×) and 0.25 μL of IS-PCR primer.
Gently pipette the reaction mixture and spin down the samples at 600 × g for 15 seconds at 20°C–25°C.
Incubate the sample tubes in a thermal cycler at 98°C for 3 minutes.
Perform 15 cycles (for bulk population RNA) or 18 cycles (for single cells) of incubation: 98°C for 20 seconds, 67°C for 15 seconds, and 72°C for 6 minutes.
Incubate the samples at 72°C for 5 minutes.
Place the thermal cycler at 4°C after reaction termination.
Purify PCR products using AMPure XP beads.
Equilibrate AMPure XP beads at 20°C–25°C for 15 minutes and vortex well.
Add 25 μL of AMPure XP beads (at a ratio of 1:1) to each sample from step 41.
Mix the reaction by pipetting and transfer the solutions to a 96-well plate.
Incubate the mixture in a 96-well plate for 8 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Place the 96-well plate on the magnetic stand for 5 minutes.
Discard the clear liquid carefully.
Wash the beads with 200 μL of 80% ethanol solution.
Incubate the samples for 30 s and then discard the ethanol.
Repeat the washing step.
Dry the beads by leaving the plate at 20°C–25°C for 5 min.
Add 17.5 μL of nuclease-free water and resuspend the beads.
Incubate the plate without the magnetic stand for 2 min.
Place the plate on the magnetic stand for 2 min.
Pipette 15 μL of the clear supernatant without disturbing the beads.
Transfer the supernatant to a 0.2-mL thin-walled PCR tube.
Check the library size distribution using a High-Sensitivity DNA chip and a Bioanalyzer (Agilent).
Set up the tagmentation reaction solution containing 500 pg of cDNA, 10 μL of a tagment DNA buffer (2×), and 5 μL of a tagment DNA enzyme mix in a final volume of 20 μL on ice.
Mix the tagmentation reaction solution by pipetting.
Perform the tagmentation reaction at 55°C for 5 minutes in a thermal cycler set to 4°C after termination.
Add 5 μL of NT buffer to each sample to strip off the tagment enzyme.
Mix the solution with NT buffer by pipetting.
Incubate the mixture at 20°C–25°C for 5 minutes.
Prepare the enrichment PCR solution containing 25 μL of tagmented DNA, 15 μL of Nextera PCR Master Mix, and 5 μL each of Index 1 and Index 2 primers in a final volume of 50 μL.
Perform PCR with initial denaturation at 95°C for 30 seconds followed by 12 cycles of “95°C for 10 s, 55°C for 30 s, and 72°C for 30 s,” and final extension at 72°C for 5 minutes.
Set the thermal cycler to 4°C after completing PCR.
Repeat step 42 but use 30 μL of AMPure XP beads (at a 0.6:1 ratio).
Transfer 15 μL of the clear supernatant into a new 1.5-mL polyallomer tube.
Measure the concentration of each library by a Qubit High-Sensitivity DNA kit and a Qubit fluorometer according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Check the size distribution of the tagmented library using a High-Sensitivity DNA chip and a Bioanalyzer (Agilent).
Calculate the molarity of the final library using the concentration obtained with the Qubit system and the average library size obtained with the Bioanalyzer.
Dilute each library to a final concentration of 4 nM.
Pool equal nanomoles of each sample, confirming that none of them has the same combination of Index 1 (N7xx) and Index 2 (N5xx) adapters.
Measure again the concentration and the library size distribution of the pooled libraries by the Qubit and Bioanalyzer systems.
Adjust the concentration to 4 nM if necessary.
